description: Declared kind of every artifact leaf a page may format (Codex L2v3 N2; v5 after QA L2v4 #4). The number-provenance gate allows x100 / a '%' display only on ratio kinds, annualisation (x periods per year) only on a per-period return at the pair's own frequency (candidates manifest ppy), and +/-1 only on counts / leads. Every NUMERIC leaf a page shows must match a rule (a numeric leaf of kind 'unknown' fails), and its value must be consistent with its kind (value_checks). The first matching rule wins; patterns are searched in the source path (file#key/path). Patterns are anchored on a path separator: a rule never matches the tail of a longer key.

value_checks.ratio: abs(value) <= 1.5 (a stored percent such as 43.48 is kind percent)
value_checks.percent: already x100: never shown x 100 again

rules.why: stored already in percent (43.48 = 43.48%): hmm/pct_*, *_ann_return_pct; *_pp: percentage points
fractions of capital or of time (0.152 = 15.2%)
strategy / B&H return, volatility and drawdown fractions
share of null contests below the statistic
share of windows / days
IS exposure bounds as fractions
annualised returns (already annualised by the pipeline), fractions
drawdown fractions
annualised regime return (pipeline), fraction
mean next-period return by quartile (per period)
mean per-period return
quantile level of a quantile regression (0.05 = 5th percentile)
HMM state probabilities

Sharpe-type ratios (never x100)
probabilities reported as p-values (shown as is)
regression coefficients, test statistics and correlations (shown as is, never scaled); transfer-entropy proxies and rank correlations
lead / lag / horizon / position shift in the pair's period unit
position changes per year, or their sum over the test period (shown as is)
counts
indicator levels and thresholds in the indicator's own units (never scaled)
calendar years
